chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Asbat, from the one who narrated to him, from Jahm ibn him, from Jahm ibn Humayd al-Rawwasi, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When you see a man spending from his wealth in obedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, then know that he has acquired it from permissible means; and when he spends it in disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, then know that he has acquired it from prohibited means.
ai.seo_question: How can one determine if their wealth is halal or haram based on their spending habits?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a diagnostic criterion where the nature of expenditure reveals the origin of wealth: spending in obedience to God indicates a source of halal, while spending in disobedience signals haram. This hadith, recorded in al-Kafi, reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the intrinsic link between spiritual conduct and material purity, suggesting that one's actions serve as a mirror for the quality of their sustenance.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ali Bin Asbat, from the one who narrated it, from Jahm Bin Humeyd Al Rawwasy who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you see the man bring out from his wealth (to spend) in obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, so know that he has earned it from Permissible means, and when he brings it would regarding disobedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, so know that he has earned it from Prohibited means’.
en.sarwar: 33. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from Ali ibn Asbat from those who narrated to him from Jahm ibn Hamid al-Rawasiy who has said the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When you see a man who takes out from his assets in obedience to Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, then you must be certain that he has earned it by lawful ways, and when he takes it in disobedience to Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, you must rest assured that he has earned it in unlawful ways.’”
